We are moving into Day 6 of the massive Amazon Black Friday sale with many of the best Apple deals of the year. Alongside the wild $100 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and the new OLED iPad mini at $100 off, we are also catching some even lower MacBook deals headlined by the new M6 Pro at $220 off (All-time low) and an insane price on the M5 MacBook Air at $400 off.  

Those deals join the M5 MacBook Air at up to $400 off, MacBook Neo starting down at $599 ($100 off), the latest Mac mini from $779, and the first discounts on the latest M6 iMac at up to $110 off. All of that and more is waiting in detail below; just make sure you grab some 2026 Apple Polishing Cloths at $9 Prime shipped before they sell out again.
